correctness.rationale: The factorization by z−α gives α^(n−1)(∑(z/α)^k−C_n); positivity and the triangle inequality put all remaining roots at radius ≥r_n|α|, with equality only for the positive-real quotient root. C_n>n; the lower equality gives a boundary root, and at and above t=1 the designated α is not interior. Reflecting the anti-analytic component (including the constant) gives the Bergman adjoint of multiplication by the conjugate-coefficient polynomial, with one-dimensional nullspace when the symbol-minus-λ has exactly one simple disk root. The Bergman monomial projection gives the analytic load z[a+h_n(z,α)], with zero constant because p_a(α)=λ; the coefficient sum is C_n. Evaluation at α cancels the sole interior pole and fixes the analytic component uniquely in zA². The essential curve and discreteness follow from the inspected spectral theorem. Independently, normalized harmonic monomial projection makes each analytic monomial shift differ from a bilateral shift power by weights tending to zero at both ends. This yields the same essential curve and index zero off it. In |λ|<|a|−1 the symbol-minus-λ has one simple disk root by Rouché; near any constructed nonzero λ the same analytic load criterion gives a finite list of possible eigenvalues, hence isolation. Both endpoint gaps are zero; the gap derivative changes sign exactly once between them, making the radial gap positive throughout. This also proves |a|>1 there. The boundary image at α/|α| attains the lower bound from the reverse triangle inequality, proving exact distance and the unique optimizer. For the lower asymptotic write r_n=1+x_n/n; bracketing x_n by c log n with fixed c below and above one and taking logs yield x_n=log n+log log n−log 6+o(1). The claimed scaled reciprocal threshold differs from x_n by o(1). The exact optimizer power tends to e^(−1), giving both other limits. Fresh rational n=4 check gave gap 187/2000 and verified projected anti-analytic rows and pole compatibility; large-degree computations were illustrative only.
residual_risks: Geometric simplicity only. The gap is to the essential curve; no whole-plane count or optimality outside the stated branch.
